title: Plynth update state, version 1
description: What an installed Plynth remembers about updates, in update-state.json in the settings folder. Only Plynth writes it. A missing file means no signed release was seen and no update was started. An unknown field is refused.

highest_signed.description: The highest version whose signature verified, as major.minor.patch. No release below it is offered. Null when none was seen.

last.description: The last update that was started. Null when none was.

from.description: The version that started the update.

to.description: The signed version of the installer that was started.

log.description: The installer's log file, absolute, with forward slashes.
